File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Trim trailing whitespace and handle blank or empty lines properly in src/ingest/parser.ts so that files ending with multiple newlines or trailing carriage returns / blank lines do not trigger malformed row assertions.
args.title: Fix parsing errors on files with trailing newlines or blank lines

Files ending with multiple newlines or CRLF line endings leave trailing empty strings or carriage returns, causing row assertions to fail on blank lines.
